objective_pt: Falar dos seus planos com "going to" e de compromissos marcados com o presente contínuo ("I'm meeting Ana on Friday"), e perguntar "What are you going to do?".

teacher.goal_pt: Ativar "going to" com planos para o fim de semana e as férias.
prompts: What are you going to do this weekend?
Do you have any plans for the holidays?
watchFor: "I go to travel" (do "eu vou viajar"); o certo é "I'm going to travel".

exercises.prompt: What are you going to do this weekend?
accepted: What are you going to do this weekend?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta, "are" vem antes de "you": "What are you going to do?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What are you going to do this weekend?

exercises.instruction_pt: Como se diz "Eu vou viajar" (um plano)?
exercises.explanation_pt: Plano para o futuro: "I'm going to" + verbo. "I go to travel" é tradução palavra por palavra.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu vou visitar minha mãe no sábado."
accepted: I'm going to visit my mother on Saturday
I am going to visit my mother on Saturday
I'm going to visit my mom on Saturday
I'm going to visit my mum on Saturday
I'm visiting my mother on Saturday
I'm visiting my mom on Saturday
On Saturday I'm going to visit my mother
On Saturday I'm going to visit my mom
I'll visit my mom on Saturday
I will visit my mother on Saturday
I'm going to see my mom on Saturday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Eu vou visitar" (futuro) é "I'm going to visit". "I go to visit" fica no presente.
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm going to visit my mother on Saturday.
I'm going to visit my mother on Saturday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o "am": "I am going to" (ou "I'm going to").
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm going to visit my mother on Saturday.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender expressões de planos: plan, hope, next year, someday, save money, look forward to.
prompts: What are you saving money for?
What do you hope to do next year?
What are you looking forward to?
watchFor: "In the next year" em vez de "next year".
"I'm looking forward to see you"; depois de "to" aqui vem "-ing": "to seeing you".

exercises.example_en: I'm saving money for a trip to Europe.
I hope to find a new job next year.
I'm looking forward to the holidays.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ligue cada expressão ao seu significado.
Diga em inglês: "Eu estou economizando dinheiro para comprar um carro."
accepted: I'm saving money to buy a car
I am saving money to buy a car
I'm saving up to buy a car
I'm saving money for a car
I'm saving up for a car
I'm saving to buy a car

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Economizar dinheiro" é "save money". "Economize" existe, mas quase não se usa assim.
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm saving money to buy a car.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Para comprar" (finalidade) é "to buy", e não "for buy".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm saving money to buy a car.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar o "going to" rápido ("gonna") na fala informal e a contração "I'll".
prompts: Say "I'm going to" fast. What do you hear?
watchFor: Escrever ou falar "gonna" em situação formal; na fala informal ele é natural.
Pronunciar "I'll" como "ai-iu" com duas vogais separadas.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. Na fala rápida, "going to" soa como "gonna".
exercises.prompt: I'm going to start a new course next month.
accepted: I'm going to start a new course next month
I'm gonna start a new course next month
I'll call you tomorrow
I will call you tomorrow

exercises.instruction_pt: Na fala informal, "I'm going to eat" costuma soar como:
exercises.explanation_pt: "Going to" + verbo vira "gonna" na fala rápida. Só não vale para "going to" + lugar: "I'm going to Rio".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender os planos de outra pessoa e responder perguntas sobre os seus.
prompts: Are you doing anything on Friday night?
Where are you going on vacation?
watchFor: Responder "Are you doing anything...?" com "Yes, I do"; aqui é "Yes, I am".
"I don't have plans" está certo, mas "Nothing special" é mais natural.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o plano da Laura.
exercises.listen: Next summer I'm going to take a cooking course in Italy. I'm already saving money for it.
options: Fazer um curso de culinária na Itália no próximo verão.
Trabalhar num restaurante na Itália neste inverno.
Economizar para comprar uma casa na Itália.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Take a cooking course" é fazer um curso de culinária, e "next summer" é no próximo verão.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que sim: você vai jantar com uns amigos.
exercises.listen: Are you doing anything on Friday night?
accepted: Yes, I'm having dinner with some friends
Yes, I am. I'm having dinner with some friends
Yes, I'm having dinner with friends
Yes, I'm going to have dinner with some friends
Yes, I'm going to have dinner with friends
Yes, I'm going out for dinner with some friends
Yeah, I'm having dinner with some friends
I'm having dinner with some friends
I'm going to have dinner with some friends
Yes, I'm meeting some friends for dinner
Yes, I'm going out to dinner with some friends

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A pergunta usa "Are you...?", então a resposta curta é "Yes, I am".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I am. I'm having dinner with some friends.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para um plano, use "I'm having dinner" ou "I'm going to have dinner".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I'm having dinner with some friends.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com refeições usamos "have" e sem artigo: "have dinner".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I'm having dinner with some friends.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que você vai para a praia.
exercises.listen: Where are you going on vacation this year?
accepted: I'm going to the beach
I am going to the beach
I'm going to go to the beach
To the beach
We're going to the beach
I'm going to the beach this year
I'm going to the coast
I'm going to the beach with my family

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para um plano futuro use "I'm going": "I'm going to the beach".

teacher.goal_pt: Falar de planos de curto e longo prazo e perguntar os planos do outro.
prompts: What are your plans for next year?
Are you going to study anything new?
Where do you see yourself in five years?
watchFor: "In the next year" em vez de "next year".
"I pretend to" querendo dizer "pretendo"; o certo é "I plan to" ou "I intend to".
Misturar "will" e "going to" o tempo todo; para planos já decididos, "going to" é o mais natural.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu pretendo mudar de casa no ano que vem."
accepted: I plan to move next year
I'm planning to move next year
I intend to move next year
I'm going to move next year
I plan to move house next year
I'm planning to move house next year
I'm planning on moving next year
I plan to move to a new house next year
Next year I'm going to move

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falso cognato: "pretend" é fingir. "Pretender" é "plan to" ou "intend to".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm planning to move next year.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Mudar de casa" é "move" (ou "move house"), e não "change house".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm planning to move next year.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No ano que vem" é só "next year", sem "in the".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm planning to move next year.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Estou ansioso para as férias."
accepted: I'm looking forward to the holidays
I am looking forward to the holidays
I'm looking forward to my vacation
I'm looking forward to the vacation
I'm really looking forward to the holidays
I can't wait for the holidays
I can't wait for my vacation
I'm excited about the holidays
I'm excited about my vacation

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Anxious" é preocupado, nervoso. Para algo bom que vai chegar, diga "I'm looking forward to..." ou "I can't wait for...".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm looking forward to the holidays.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "look forward to", com "to".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm looking forward to the holidays.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa para formar a frase.
accepted: We are going to get married next year
Next year we are going to get married

exercises.instruction_pt: Conte para a Sam os seus planos para o próximo ano.
exercises.prompt_en: Next year is going to be a big year for me. I'm going to start a new job, and I'm planning to learn the guitar. What about you? What are your plans for next year?
guidelines_pt: Diga 2 planos com "I'm going to..." ou "I'm planning to...".
Diga algo que você espera: "I hope to...".
Pergunte de volta: "Are you going to...?" ou "What are you looking forward to?".

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar "going to", presente contínuo para compromissos e expressões de tempo futuro.
prompts: What are you going to do after this class?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "O que você vai fazer amanhã?"
accepted: What are you going to do tomorrow?
What are you doing tomorrow?
What will you do tomorrow?
What are your plans for tomorrow?
What're you doing tomorrow?
What are you gonna do tomorrow?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta o verbo auxiliar vem antes de "you": "What are you going to do?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What are you going to do tomorrow?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vai fazer" é "are going to do", e não "go to do".
commonErrors.correction_en: What are you going to do tomorrow?

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete com a forma certa de "be".
exercises.sentence: They ___ going to buy a new house.
accepted: are

commonErrors.correction_en: They are going to buy a new house.

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual frase fala de um compromisso já marcado?
options: I'm meeting the dentist at three tomorrow.
exercises.explanation_pt: O presente contínuo ("I'm meeting") com um horário marcado fala do futuro próximo.

exercises.prompt: I'm really looking forward to it!
accepted: I'm really looking forward to it
I am really looking forward to it
